name: Corsair Endurance
description: Hold the line through a prolonged hostile contact without losing every operational asset.

objectives.title: Fleet Destroyed
objectives.description: Failure: all player assets have been lost.

objectives.title: Survive the Contact
objectives.description: Keep at least one operational asset alive for five minutes.

actions.text: The hostile pressure is breaking. Hold formation.

objectives.title: Optional: Combat Screen
objectives.description: Field two armed combat ships during the engagement.

completionText: The fleet survived the Corsair pressure and retained operational control.
failureText: All operational assets were lost before the attack could be weathered.
